summary: Focused retest of the iter-102 HIGH cascade bug fix plus 2 minor fixes (v56s). All requested items PASS. Contract-type selects on /tenders/all, /register Section D and /vendor/categories are enabled without picking a sector first. Each one has 31 options (placeholder + all 30 types). They are grouped into 5 optgroups (EPC, PPP, Services, Supply, Works); framework and om have no children, so they show as plain options. Child types ppp-bot (BOT) and services-advisory can be selected. Picking ppp-bot on the board cuts it from 20 rows to 1, and the Sector·Country column shows 'Power & Energy'. The deep link ?sector=power&contract=ppp-bot restores both selects and survives a refresh. Clear all filters empties both and removes the query string from the URL. Section D: choosing ppp-bot and then power, saving the draft and reloading keeps both, and Mongo has sector_code/sector_name/contract_type_code/contract_type_name. With go-live ON, Section D shows 'Sector *' and 'Contract type *' with the 'Required — the portal is live.' hint. Vendor category request posted sector=power and contract=services-advisory, confirmed via GET /vendor/categories/mine. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass, including a new test showing a rejected (422) go-live notice create does not use up a notice_seq number (two consecutive successful notices are numbered N and N+1 with 2 rejections in between), and a new power+ppp-bot public filter test. go-live was reset to FALSE (verified).

ui_bugs.issue: Leftover cascade code: changing the Sector select still resets Contract type to '' (setContractType('') in TendersList.jsx ~L168 and ~L365; contract_type_code:'' in VendorCategories.jsx ~L123). The two selects are now independent, so a user who picks a contract type and then a sector loses the contract type. SectionD does not do this.

issues: Pending entries do not show the chosen sector/contract type, so the vendor cannot see the taxonomy they submitted (optional enhancement).

action_items: (LOW) Remove the contract-type reset in the sector onChange handlers in TendersList.jsx (desktop aside + legacy layout) and VendorCategories.jsx, since sector no longer filters contract type.
critical_code_review_comments: notices.py: go-live gate now runs before next_sequence(); verified no gap in the sequence.
taxonomy.jsx: groups without children (framework, om) render as plain options outside any optgroup. This is fine, but the order mixes optgroups and plain options.
